verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a documented public REST API (Lambda Cloud API) with a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering instance provisioning, cluster launch, filesystems, and firewall management, confirmed both in docs and via runtime probe returning the full spec and a key-gated endpoint. Community evidence further shows a third-party built a CLI/MCP server on top of this API enabling AI agents to launch/terminate GPU instances programmatically, corroborating real-world agentic usability. Missing for 10: an official first-party SDK/MCP server and an llms.txt (probe found 404), so slight extra integration work is needed.
